findings.title: zip of error_ids with get_multi values mis-associates IDs
findings.body: fetch_error_details zips error_ids with events.values(). nodestore get_multi returns a dict keyed by node id; any missing or reordered entries pair the wrong event_id with the wrong event data. Iterate over node_ids and look each one up with events.get(node_id) instead.

findings.title: Reference to PRCommentWorkflow inside CommitContextIntegration staticmethod
findings.body: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template is defined on CommitContextIntegration, but it calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title, and _truncate_title is also defined on CommitContextIntegration. The github/gitlab workflows call self.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template on a PRCommentWorkflow subclass. Either the method is unreachable on that class (AttributeError), or the truncate helper is missing on PRCommentWorkflow. The methods look like they were placed in the wrong class.

findings.title: request.user.id may fail for org auth token requests
findings.body: The analytics event is recorded before the feature check using request.user.id. With org auth token authentication, request.user is AnonymousUser, whose id is None, so the event is emitted with a missing user. The event is also emitted for orgs that don't have the feature enabled. Record it after the feature check and handle the case where there is no authenticated user.

findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization renders with empty data
findings.body: When the feature flag is enabled, the table is passed hardcoded empty columns and data instead of tableResults. Users with the flag will see empty tables.

findings.title: age/timestamp exclusivity check is truthy-based
findings.body: The validators use initial_data.get(...) as a truthiness test, so age=0 or timestamp=0 is not detected as present. A report that includes both fields with one of them equal to 0 passes validation even though it should be rejected.

findings.title: Disabled query reports pending forever
findings.body: When the feature is disabled, the useApiQuery is not enabled and isPending stays true. The hook then reports pending indefinitely, so any consumer that checks pending before checking the feature flag will show a loading state that never resolves.
